capabilities: Search Globasa and English entries offline
Show entry cards with word class and translation
Copy a Globasa word to the clipboard
Look up words on hover in reading and editor views
Pin and drag hover result cards
extras: The word list is bundled in main.js, so lookups need no network, account or payment; clipboard is written only when the user clicks a result.
problem: Looking up Globasa words means leaving Obsidian for an online dictionary or the official repository.
summary: Offline Globasa dictionary with a searchable sidebar panel and optional hover lookups in reading and editor views.
